name: Pack Rat
description: Survives by keeping everything because you never know what you'll need
behavioral_signature: Pockets bulging, bags overflowing, still grabbing more
under_stress: Hoarding becomes compulsive and irrational, slowing them down
at_rest: Sorting, organizing, and admiring their collection
will_always: keep something others would throw away
unless: dropping weight is literally the difference between life and death
